name: n13-coax-icon
prompt: phobosvanilla, A short coil of thick black coaxial radio cable, loosely looped twice, with a shiny silver screw-on connector plug clearly visible on its free end and a short straight tail of cable. Draw it in exactly the art style of the reference images: a small game icon with a very thick near-black outline, bold simple shapes, flat cel shading and a muted palette, readable when shrunk to a thumbnail. One object, centred, filling most of the canvas, on a plain pure white background. Not a tyre, not a ring, not a hose, not a rope. No text, no letters, no numbers, no hands, no people.
subject: a short coil of black coaxial cable with a silver connector plug on its free end
